evidence.quote: None of the toilets are wheelchair accessible.
There is one 20 cm step up to the entrance from street level.

findings.value: Inside, the ground floor is level. The basement club room, open on Friday and Saturday nights, is reached only by a spiral staircase. A ramp is available at the front door on request. PAs and access workers get free entry if they email ahead. Smoke and strobe can be switched off if asked in advance.

evidence.quote: We have a ramp available, please let a member of the door team know if you would like to use the ramp.
There is level access to all facilities on this floor.
This space is accessible by stairs only.
We offer free entry for PAs or access-workers.
To arrange free or concession entry, please email us ahead of your visit.
Please let us know in advance if you would like us to avoid using either/both the smoke machine and strobe light.

findings.value: Challenge 25 at the door; security may ask for ID.

evidence.quote: Security operate a ‘challenge 25’ policy, and may ask you for ID.
The venue can hold up to 230 people at once during a busy weekend party, across 2 floors.
It is usually free to enter before 10pm.

findings.value: Paid club nights usually cost £7 to £10, and entry is usually free before 10pm. Free concession tickets for people on low or no income, arranged by email.

evidence.quote: generally charge an entry fee between £7 – 10.
We offer free concession tickets if you are on low or no income.

not_found: accessibility.step_free: left empty on purpose. There is one 20 cm step with a ramp on request, the ground floor is level, and the basement club is stairs only, so no plain statement covers the whole venue
